summary: Mach Natural Resources LP filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $100 million in common units through Morgan Stanley as sales agent. The units trade on NYSE under MNR, last at $14.14 on May 21, 2026. Sales will be made under Rule 415(a)(4) on the NYSE or in negotiated transactions; the agent receives 2.5% commission. Proceeds are for general purposes. No special-situation event (e.g., acquisition, tender, restructuring) is present; this is a routine shelf takedown/equity distribution agreement filing.
